title: Bagel's Reusable Sculk Shriekers
description: Sculk Shriekers mined with Silk Touch can summon Wardens.
body:
Allows Sculk Shriekers mined with Silk Touch to summon Wardens anywhere the Sculk Shrieker is placed.

You could build your own Deep Dark cities, build a biome themed around a Warden, create traps or use them to protect your base from other players, for example.

Supports Multiplayer.

Made for Java 1.21.6.
